observations.code_quote: The **Charts** picker also includes proportion bars, scatter plots, and box plots. Scatter plots initialize numeric axes and need at least two numeric columns; box plots need six numeric summary columns. With two measures, **X measure** and **Y measure** choose the axes. Dimensions on Rows and Columns define point detail, including a dimension selected for Color. Without dimensions, the measures form one aggregate point. Category colors remain stable when results reorder, and aliases do not change category identity. Missing coordinates are omitted; logarithmic axes require positive coordinates.
